shots.name: Shooter Lane / Plunger
shots.notes: Manual plunger with strength gauge. Full plunge rides the arch and drops into the Starts Character saucer; soft plunges dribble back down the right orbit.

shots.name: Starts Character Saucer
shots.notes: Top-center kickout saucer behind the pops, under a fan of 5 skill-shot arrows. Any drop-in starts a character; ejects into the bumpers.

shots.name: 1-2 Top Rollover Lanes
shots.notes: Two top rollovers flanking the saucer; half of the 1-2-3-4 lane set. Lane-change with flipper buttons.

shots.name: Jack Rabbit Slim's Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Three pops (Jack, Rabbit, Slim's) on the Twist Contest dance-floor art. Sling/pop hits cycle the lit Roll Scene.

shots.name: Hold Cast / Big Kahuna Left Standup
shots.notes: Upper-left standup, dual function: Big Kahuna qualify target and Hold Cast (carries collected characters to the next ball). Right-flipper shot.

shots.name: Big Kahuna Right Standup
shots.notes: Upper-right standup under the briefcase chute; second Big Kahuna qualify target. Left-flipper shot.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Full left loop hugging the wall; Payoff shot #1 and a Drive Fast orbit. Gate opens during Drive Fast to loop to the right orbit. Best from the right flipper.

shots.name: Left Super Spinner
shots.notes: Hall-effect spinner in the left orbit lane. Adds MPH during Drive Fast; 1k/spin when Super Spinners are lit.

shots.name: Briefcase Boogie Lane
shots.notes: Inner-left lane: 3 inline memory drop targets guarding a popper that kicks locks up to the back-panel briefcase trough. Payoff shot #2. Right-flipper shot.

shots.name: Left Red-Arrow 2-Bank
shots.notes: Two stacked standups below the left orbit entrance; part of the seven red-arrow targets that spell PULP FICTION. Right-flipper shots.

shots.name: Royale with Cheese Target
shots.notes: Yellow standup beside the burger sculpture. Collects the 1-2-3-4 hurry-up, lights Collect Gun Bonus and both Super Spinners.

shots.name: Pawn Shop Drop Bank
shots.notes: Center 3-bank 'front door' (resets after each lock); carries 3 of the 7 red arrows. Opens the scoop behind it.

shots.name: Pawn Shop Scoop
shots.notes: Hidden behind the drop bank; subway lock for Pawn Shop Panic, Frenzy start/payoff shot, Payoff shot #3. Subway kicks balls out above the left slingshot.

shots.name: Drive Fast Collect Target
shots.notes: Recessed standup hidden behind the right end of the Pawn Shop bank (reachable when that drop is down). Cashes the MPH Bonus; 146+ MPH lights Extra Ball.

shots.name: Roll Scene Drop Target
shots.notes: Memory drop guarding the Roll Scene saucer. 1st/2nd hits light left/right outlane ball saves; The Shot's repeat target; backhandable from the right flipper.

shots.name: Roll Scene Saucer
shots.notes: Right saucer behind the drop; starts and collects scenes, collects characters (up to 5x), a Divine Intervention start shot. Payoff shot #4. Left-flipper shot.

shots.name: Right Red-Arrow 2-Bank
shots.notes: Two standups between the Roll Scene lane and right orbit; final 2 of the 7 red-arrow targets. Left-flipper shots.

shots.name: Bullseye Magnet Target
shots.notes: Standup at the end of the gun-barrel line; triggers the grab magnet catch. Advances Big Kahuna X, collects Gun Bonus, Gold Watch scene shot, Divine Intervention final shot. Most valuable and most dangerous shot — misses rebound hot.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Full right loop inside the shooter lane; Payoff shot #5 and a Drive Fast orbit; landing lane for briefcase lock releases. Left-flipper shot.

shots.name: Right Super Spinner
shots.notes: Hall-effect spinner in the right orbit lane; MPH builder during Drive Fast, 1k/spin when Super Spinners are lit.

shots.name: Left Inlane ('3' Lane)
shots.notes: Left return lane of the 1-2-3-4 set. When already lit, rolling through briefly lights the RIGHT orbit for Drive Fast.

shots.name: Right Inlane ('4' Lane)
shots.notes: Right return lane of the 1-2-3-4 set. When already lit, rolling through briefly lights the LEFT orbit for Drive Fast.

goals.title: All-Arrows Skill Shot
goals.summary: Time a full plunge into the Starts Character saucer with all five arrows lit for 100,000 — and any drop-in starts a character toward Cast Chaos.
goals.reward: 100,000 + character started

steps.action: Full plunge into the top saucer
steps.detail: The five arrows light in sequence — leftmost, rightmost, left, right, center — until all 5 are lit; never plunge soft, since a weak plunge rolls back down the right orbit. Scores 3,000 per lit arrow (15k max) plus a 100k bonus with all five lit, and any successful drop-in starts a random character.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot
goals.summary: Hold the left flipper on the plunge to light all five Payoff arrows, then make any one for 100,000 with a controlled ball.

steps.action: Plunge through, then shoot any lit Payoff shot before the timer expires
steps.detail: All five Payoff arrow inserts light on a timer. A hard plunge that completes the loop can register the left orbit instantly. Left orbit, briefcase lane, Pawn Shop scoop, Roll Scene, or right orbit — 100k. Pick the shot you want to practice.

goals.title: Drive Fast MPH Loop Farm
goals.summary: The game's de facto combo: lit inlane → opposite orbit → chain loops while spinners build MPH, then cash MPH Bonus at the hidden target. IFPA-challenge-proven multi-million collects.
goals.reward: 20k–100k per loop + 1,000 x MPH collect (x Kahuna X); 146+ MPH lights Extra Ball

steps.action: Roll through an already-lit 3 or 4 return lane
steps.detail: Briefly lights the OPPOSITE orbit for Drive Fast — treat it like a combo window and shoot promptly.

steps.action: Immediately rip the lit orbit
steps.detail: 20k; the top gate opens and the ball loops around to the other orbit, feeding the next shot.

steps.action: Keep chaining loops back and forth
steps.detail: 40k/60k/80k up to 100k per loop; spinner spins add +1 MPH each, escalating to +5 per spin on the 5th consecutive loop. Uncollected MPH only carries between Drive Fast runs on the same ball, so cash it before you drain.

steps.action: Cash the MPH Bonus at the hidden target behind the Pawn Shop drops
steps.detail: 1,000 x MPH, multiplied by Big Kahuna playfield X — collect with the front drop down and the multiplier high. 146+ MPH lights Extra Ball.

goals.title: Royale with Cheese → Gun Bonus Cash-Out
goals.summary: Complete the 1-2-3-4 lanes, cash the hurry-up at the Royale target, then bank the Gun Bonus mid-ball at the magnet — multiplied by Bonus X AND playfield X.
goals.reward: Gun Bonus (max 160k) x Bonus X (max 10x) x Kahuna X — theoretical 9.6M

steps.action: Complete the 1-2-3-4 lanes
steps.detail: Two top lanes plus both inlanes; use flipper lane-change. Each completion advances Bonus X and starts the Royale hurry-up.

steps.action: Hit the Royale with Cheese target before the hurry-up expires
steps.detail: Scores the hurry-up, lights Collect Gun Bonus at the magnet target, and lights both Super Spinners (1k/spin).

steps.action: Shoot the Bullseye Magnet target to bank the Gun Bonus
steps.detail: Collect when Bonus X and Kahuna X are both high — collecting resets the bonus string and Bonus X. If Advance Kahuna is also lit, the X advances FIRST, then the bonus collects.

goals.title: Scene Collect Snowball
goals.summary: Collect a scene at the saucer in its last 10 seconds to re-award it PLUS every previous scene collect — compounding those late collects is where the enormous scores come from.
goals.reward: Compounding scene collects, multiplied by Kahuna X; feeds The Shot

steps.action: Knock down the Roll Scene drop target
steps.detail: Qualifies a scene and lights an outlane ball save as a bonus.

steps.action: Cycle the lit scene with sling and bumper hits
steps.detail: The lit scene changes on every slingshot/pop hit — line up Gold Watch, the richest scene (100k+ per hit).

steps.action: Shoot the saucer to start the 40-second scene
steps.detail: Build Kahuna X to 2x–6x BEFORE starting — the multiplier applies to both the build and the collect.

steps.action: Build value on the scene's shots
steps.detail: Gold Watch: hammer the Bullseye Magnet target. Other scenes use pops, red arrows, or spinners.

steps.action: Shoot the saucer again in the FINAL 10 seconds to collect
steps.detail: Re-awards the built value plus ALL previous scene collects. An uncollected scene adds nothing to the chain.

goals.title: Cast Chaos Super Payoff Lap
goals.summary: Inside Cast Chaos multiball, sweep all five 100k Payoff shots then hit the top saucer for the 500k Super Payoff — roughly a million per lap, repeatable.
goals.reward: ~1M per full lap (5 x 100k + 500k), relights indefinitely

steps.action: Shoot the left orbit Payoff (100k)
steps.detail: All five Payoff arrows strobe multicolor during Cast Chaos; each collected turns white.

steps.action: Shoot the Briefcase Boogie lane Payoff (100k)
Shoot the Pawn Shop scoop Payoff (100k)
Shoot the Roll Scene saucer Payoff (100k)
Shoot the right orbit Payoff (100k)
Shoot the Starts Character saucer for the 500k Super Payoff
steps.detail: Relights all five Payoffs — repeat the lap until you're back to one ball. Kahuna X multiplies everything.

goals.title: Briefcase Boogie Multiball
goals.summary: Clear the three inline drops, lock three balls behind the rotating briefcase, then climb the red/yellow/green payoff ladder to 250k blue Super Payoffs.
goals.reward: 25k/50k/75k payoff ladder; Super Payoffs 250k each; all four restart the MB at 2x base

steps.action: Knock down all 3 inline combination drops
steps.detail: Drop progress is remembered ball-to-ball by default.

steps.action: Shoot the open lane to the popper to lock a ball
steps.detail: The ball is kicked up to the back-panel trough beside the briefcase; a new ball auto-serves. Lock 3 to start the 3-ball multiball.

steps.action: Collect flashing red Payoffs at the other four major shots (25k each)
steps.detail: Collect one, then the briefcase lane relights to advance. Yellow needs two (50k), green needs three (75k).

steps.action: Shoot the briefcase lane each time it relights to advance the color
steps.detail: Red → yellow → green; each phase adds +1x to payoff values.

steps.action: Lock all remaining balls to qualify the blue Super Payoff stage
steps.detail: Super Payoffs are 250k per shot; one Super Payoff lights the objective toward Divine Intervention, and collecting all four restarts the multiball at 2x.

goals.title: Pawn Shop Panic Multiball
goals.summary: The forgiving beginner multiball: open the Pawn Shop drop bank, lock three in the subway scoop, then farm drop-and-scoop payoffs to blue Super Payoffs at all five shots.
goals.reward: Payoffs ~15k/30k/90k; Super Payoffs 100k at all five shots, endlessly relighting; payoff level carries across attempts

steps.action: Knock down all three front-door drops to open the shop
steps.detail: The bank resets after each lock — you re-open the shop for every lock.

steps.action: Shoot the scoop to lock a ball in the subway
steps.detail: Repeat drops → scoop for locks 2 and 3; three locks starts the 3-ball multiball. Watch the subway kickout above the left slingshot.

steps.action: In multiball, hit any one drop 3 times
steps.detail: Each hit resets the bank; three hits flash the Pawn Shop Payoff arrow red.

steps.action: Send ALL remaining balls into the scoop to collect the payoff
steps.detail: Repeat the cycle through red → yellow → green levels; balls kick back out each time.

steps.action: Reach the blue Super Payoff stage — all five major shots flash blue at 100k each
steps.detail: Clearing all five relights the whole set; one Super Payoff lights the objective. Runs while 2+ balls stay in play.

goals.title: Cast Chaos
goals.summary: Start characters at the top saucer, cash them in multiples at the Roll Scene saucer (up to 5x), Hold Cast to protect them — collect all five to launch the 4-ball Cast Chaos multiball.
goals.reward: Character collects x up to 5x; MB: 5 x 100k Payoffs + 500k Super Payoff laps

steps.action: Shoot the Starts Character saucer to start the lit character
steps.detail: The skill shot also starts a random character — every plunge is Cast Chaos progress.

steps.action: Shoot the Roll Scene saucer to COLLECT flashing characters
steps.detail: Award multiplies by the number of characters started at once, up to 5x — start several before cashing in.

steps.action: Hit the Hold Cast standup (upper left) to keep your characters
steps.detail: Carries all collected characters to the next ball; unheld characters reset at drain.

steps.action: Collect all five characters to start Cast Chaos
steps.detail: 4-ball multiball starts immediately (3 extra balls served). Sweep the five 100k Payoffs, then this saucer for the 500k Super Payoff.

goals.title: Pulp Fiction Frenzy
goals.summary: Spell P-U-L-P F-I-C-T-I-O-N by completing the three red-arrow banks, then start a 4-ball switch frenzy at the Pawn Shop scoop — 5k per switch with repeatable 500k scoop payoffs.
goals.reward: 5k/switch; 500k scoop Payoff on every re-spell, repeatable all multiball

steps.action: Complete the center 3-bank for letters
steps.detail: Each completed red-arrow bank = 1 letter (11 total). The center bank pulls double duty — it also opens Pawn Shop locks.

steps.action: Complete the left red-arrow 2-bank
steps.detail: Right-flipper shots below the left orbit entrance.

steps.action: Complete the right red-arrow 2-bank
steps.detail: Left-flipper shots; these often complete 'by accident' while shooting the right side.

steps.action: With all 11 letters spelled, shoot the Pawn Shop scoop to start
steps.detail: 4-ball frenzy (3 extra balls served): every switch scores 5k, every ~10 switches spots a letter.

steps.action: Each time PULP FICTION re-spells, shoot the scoop for 500k
steps.detail: The sequence restarts indefinitely while the multiball lasts — low aiming risk, big floor.

goals.title: Gold Watch Scene
goals.summary: The richest of the four Roll Scene movie modes: 40 seconds of 100k+ Bullseye Magnet hits, collected at the saucer in the final 10 seconds.
goals.reward: 100k+ per magnet hit x Kahuna X; collect adds to the snowball

steps.action: Hit the Roll Scene drop target to qualify a scene
steps.detail: 'Quiet on the set!' — one of the four scene inserts lights.

steps.action: Cycle to Gold Watch with sling/bumper hits
steps.detail: The lit scene changes on every slingshot or pop hit — the Captain Koons plastic flashes when Gold Watch is up.

steps.action: Shoot the saucer to start the 40-second scene
Hammer the Bullseye Magnet target — 100k+ per hit
steps.detail: Clean hits get magnet-caught (safe trap); misses rebound hot toward the center. Highest risk, highest reward.

steps.action: Collect at the saucer in the final 10 seconds
steps.detail: Banks the build plus all previous scene collects.

goals.title: Clean the Car Scene
goals.summary: Roll Scene spinner mode — rip both orbit Super Spinners hard for 40 seconds, then collect at the saucer.
goals.reward: Value per spin (rip hard); collect feeds the snowball and The Shot

steps.action: Hit the Roll Scene drop target to qualify a scene
Start Clean the Car at the saucer
steps.detail: Both Super Spinner inserts flash; cycle scenes with sling/pop hits beforehand if needed.

steps.action: Rip the left orbit spinner from the right flipper
steps.detail: Full-power orbit shots maximize spins per shot.

steps.action: Rip the right orbit spinner from the left flipper
Collect at the saucer in the final 10 seconds

goals.title: BMF Wallet Scene
goals.summary: Roll Scene target mode — hit the seven red-arrow targets (left 2-bank, center 3-bank, right 2-bank) at ~10k+ each, then collect.
goals.reward: ~10k+ per red-arrow target; also advances PULP FICTION letters

steps.action: Hit the Roll Scene drop target to qualify a scene
Start BMF Wallet at the saucer
steps.detail: All seven red-arrow targets light.

steps.action: Sweep the center 3-bank
steps.detail: Doubles as Pawn Shop lock progress.

steps.action: Pick off the left 2-bank from the right flipper
Pick off the right 2-bank from the left flipper
Collect at the saucer in the final 10 seconds

goals.title: Twist Contest Scene
goals.summary: The easiest Roll Scene mode — bash the Jack Rabbit Slim's pop bumpers for 40 seconds and collect at the saucer.
goals.reward: ~2k+ per bumper hit; safe scene to learn the collect timing

steps.action: Hit the Roll Scene drop target to qualify a scene
Start Twist Contest at the saucer
steps.detail: The three pops flash on the dance floor.

steps.action: Feed the ball into the bumpers repeatedly
steps.detail: Shots to the top saucer and orbits recycle through the pop nest.

steps.action: Collect at the saucer in the final 10 seconds

goals.title: Big Kahuna Playfield X
goals.summary: The game's core scoring lever: two standups then the magnet target doubles ALL scoring for the rest of the ball — repeat up to 6x, then start your scene or multiball.
goals.reward: 2x playfield per completion, up to 6x, lasts until drain

steps.action: Hit the left Big Kahuna standup by the pops
steps.detail: Right-flipper shot into the upper-left pocket.

steps.action: Hit the right Big Kahuna standup
steps.detail: Both standups light Advance Big Kahuna at the magnet target.

steps.action: Shoot the Bullseye Magnet target to advance the multiplier
steps.detail: 2x first, then 3x/4x/5x/6x on repeats. Single-ball play only — build it BEFORE scenes or multiball. The magnet catch hands you a free trap.

goals.title: Bonus X via 1-2-3-4 Lanes
goals.summary: Complete the four Royale with Cheese lanes to advance Bonus X toward 10x on the Gun Bonus — 6x lights Extra Ball.
goals.reward: +1 Bonus X per completion (max 10x); 6x lights Extra Ball

steps.action: Roll the 1 and 2 top lanes, lane-changing with the flippers
steps.detail: Move lit lanes under the ball whenever it's in the pop nest.

steps.action: Fill the 3 lane on left returns
Fill the 4 lane on right returns
steps.detail: Each full 1-2-3-4 completion adds +1 Bonus X and starts the Royale hurry-up. Bonus X multiplies the Gun Bonus at end of ball or on a mid-ball collect.

goals.title: The Shot (Mini-Wizard)
goals.summary: Complete all four scenes to unlock the untimed 4-ball mini-wizard where every Roll Scene drop hit pays 10% of your accumulated scene collect value.
goals.reward: Each drop hit = 10% of total Roll Scene collect base, escalating red→yellow→green→blue→RGB

steps.action: Complete all four scenes (Twist Contest, BMF Wallet, Gold Watch, Clean the Car)
steps.detail: Start AND collect each at this saucer — big collects directly inflate The Shot's per-hit value.

steps.action: Start The Shot at the Roll Scene saucer
steps.detail: 4-ball multiball, no timer; scene lane inserts scroll toward the drop target.

steps.action: Hit the Roll Scene drop target over and over
steps.detail: Award escalates through red → yellow → green → blue → RGB; runs while 2+ balls are in play. Finishing lights the Roll Scene objective; the banked scene value resets afterward.

goals.title: Divine Intervention (Wizard Mode)
goals.summary: Light all five objective inserts, then survive six escalating stages of renewing 4-ball multiball. Completing it DOUBLES your entire score; draining out resets all progress.
goals.reward: Entire score DOUBLED on completion; all-or-nothing

steps.action: Objective 1: collect a Briefcase Boogie Super Payoff
steps.detail: Lock 3, climb red/yellow/green, relock for blue.

steps.action: Objective 2: collect a Pawn Shop Panic Super Payoff
Objective 3: finish The Shot
steps.detail: Requires all four scenes completed first.

steps.action: Objective 4: complete the cast and play Cast Chaos
Objective 5: spell PULP FICTION and play Pulp Fiction Frenzy
Start Divine Intervention at either strobing shot
steps.detail: The Roll Scene saucer and Briefcase lane insert strings strobe upward — make either. The playfield goes dark.

steps.action: Stage 1: shoot the Briefcase Boogie lane 6 times
steps.detail: 3 to drop the inline targets, 3 more to light the sign's locks. Balls renew at each new stage — but draining ALL balls fails the mode and resets everything.

steps.action: Stage 2: shoot the Pawn Shop scoop 3 times
Stage 3: hit the Roll Scene drop target 5 times
Stage 4: shoot the Starts Character saucer 5 times
Stage 5: hit all seven red-arrow targets
steps.detail: Left 2-bank, center 3-bank, right 2-bank — one FICTION letter per target.

steps.action: Stage 6: keep one ball alive and hit the Bullseye Magnet target
steps.detail: No more ball renewal. The magnet catches the ball and your entire score doubles.

goals.title: Tournament Opener: Multiplier First
goals.summary: The consensus competitive line: insurance, then Kahuna X, then a multiplied Gold Watch collect — build the multiplier before you spend it.
goals.reward: Multiplied scene collects — the acknowledged path to giant scores

steps.action: Full plunge timed for all five arrows
steps.detail: 100k plus a character qualified either way.

steps.action: Trap right, backhand the Roll Scene drop target
steps.detail: Lights the left outlane ball save — do this early, every ball; hit it again later for the right save.

steps.action: Hit both Big Kahuna standups, then the magnet target, for 2x
steps.detail: Repeat to 3x if the ball is behaving. Single-ball play only — multiplier work comes before scenes and multiballs.

steps.action: Start Gold Watch and collect in the last 10 seconds
steps.detail: Cycle the lit scene with sling/pop hits; a 2x–3x Gold Watch collect is game-winning and fattens every future collect and The Shot.

steps.action: Feed Pawn Shop locks off the center bank between scenes
steps.detail: Keeps a multiball in your back pocket for safe Super Payoff laps.

goals.title: Beginner: First 30 Seconds
goals.summary: The forgiving opening: plunge for the saucer, buy outlane insurance, then grind the drop-bank-to-scoop loop into Pawn Shop Panic.
goals.reward: Ball save lit + easiest multiball qualified

steps.action: Full plunge — never soft
steps.detail: A soft plunge dribbles back down the right orbit; any saucer drop-in starts a character.

steps.action: Backhand the right drop target from the right flipper
steps.detail: Lights the left outlane ball save — pure insurance.

steps.action: Pound the center 3-bank to open the Pawn Shop
steps.detail: Also spells PULP FICTION letters by accident.

steps.action: Shoot the scoop to lock; repeat to 3 locks for Pawn Shop Panic
steps.detail: The bank resets each lock; lock progress persists ball-to-ball. Expect 1–2 locks before a drain — it carries over.

steps.action: Lane-change the 1-2-3-4 lanes whenever the ball is up top
steps.detail: Each completion bumps Bonus X toward 10x and lights the Royale hurry-up.

goals.title: PF Frenzy Rush
goals.summary: A proven first-ball line: complete PULP on ball one by hammering the center bank, let the side arrows come by accident, then live in the 4-ball frenzy.
goals.reward: Early 4-ball multiball with 500k scoop payoffs and low aiming risk

steps.action: Plunge the skill shot
steps.detail: Free 100k and a character.

steps.action: Light the left outlane save with one drop-target hit
Hammer the center red-arrow bank for letters
steps.detail: It double-dips: letters toward PULP FICTION plus Pawn Shop lock progress. The left/right 2-banks fill in 'by accident.'

steps.action: If you get a clean single-ball window, add Big Kahuna X first
steps.detail: Two standups then the magnet target — Frenzy switch scoring multiplies too.

steps.action: With 11 letters spelled, shoot the scoop to start the Frenzy
steps.detail: Hit everything at 5k/switch and shoot the scoop for 500k every time PULP FICTION re-completes.

goals.title: Outlane Insurance (Both Sides)
goals.summary: Two hits on the Roll Scene drop target buy you a save on each outlane — the cheapest survival play on the machine, and it also qualifies a scene.
goals.reward: Left and right outlane ball saves lit, plus a scene qualified

steps.action: Full plunge and settle the ball on the right flipper
steps.detail: Trap up before you shoot — this target is a controlled shot, not a reflex swing.

steps.action: Backhand the drop target from a right-flipper trap for the LEFT outlane save
steps.detail: The first hit of the ball lights the left save. The drop remembers its state, so it stays down until the saucer is used.

steps.action: Use the qualified scene or let the saucer reset the drop
steps.detail: The drop pops back up once the scene starts, giving you a second target to shoot at.

steps.action: Hit the drop target a second time for the RIGHT outlane save
steps.detail: With both saves lit, an outlane drain kicks the ball back into play — do this early on every ball you can.

achievements.title: Full Arrow Plunge
achievements.desc: Land the plunge in the top saucer with all five skill-shot arrows lit for the 100,000 bonus.

achievements.title: Insurance On Both Sides
achievements.desc: Light the left and right outlane ball saves on the same ball by hitting the Roll Scene drop target twice.

achievements.title: Shop Opened
achievements.desc: Lock three balls through the Pawn Shop drops and scoop to start Pawn Shop Panic multiball.

achievements.title: Danced The Contest
achievements.desc: Start the Twist Contest scene and collect it at the Roll Scene saucer before time runs out.

achievements.title: Burger Run
achievements.desc: Complete the 1-2-3-4 lanes and beat the timer to the Royale with Cheese target for the hurry-up.

achievements.title: Held Plunge Payoff
achievements.desc: Hold the left flipper on the plunge and cash one of the five lit Payoff shots for 100,000.

achievements.title: Three In The Case
achievements.desc: Clear the inline drops and lock three balls behind the briefcase to start Briefcase Boogie multiball.

achievements.title: Wallet Sweep
achievements.desc: Start the BMF Wallet scene and collect it at the saucer before the 40 seconds expire.

achievements.title: Spinners Cleaned
achievements.desc: Start the Clean the Car scene, rip both orbit spinners, and collect it at the saucer.

achievements.title: Eleven Letters
achievements.desc: Spell out every letter with the three red-arrow banks and start the frenzy multiball at the scoop.

achievements.title: Full Cast Assembled
achievements.desc: Start and collect all five characters to launch the four-ball Cast Chaos multiball.

achievements.title: Past 146
achievements.desc: Build the Drive Fast speed counter past 146 MPH and cash it at the hidden collect target to light Extra Ball.

achievements.title: Watch Recovered
achievements.desc: Start the Gold Watch scene and collect it in its final ten seconds after building value at the magnet target.

achievements.title: Six Times Over
achievements.desc: Run the two Big Kahuna standups and the magnet target enough times to reach the 6x playfield multiplier.

achievements.title: Bonus Ceiling
achievements.desc: Complete the 1-2-3-4 lanes ten times in one game to max the bonus multiplier.

achievements.title: Blue Briefcase Payoff
achievements.desc: Climb the Briefcase Boogie payoff ladder to the blue stage and collect a Super Payoff.

achievements.title: Clean Payoff Lap
achievements.desc: During Cast Chaos, collect all five Payoff shots and then the top saucer Super Payoff in one lap.

achievements.title: Finished The Shot
achievements.desc: Complete all four scenes, start the untimed mini-wizard, and play it out to its final award level.

achievements.title: Score Doubled
achievements.desc: Light all five objectives, then clear all six wizard-mode stages to double your entire score.

drills.title: Five-Arrow Plunge
drills.text: Full plunge every time and watch the arrow fan light in sequence before the ball drops into the saucer. A weak plunge dribbles back down the right orbit and costs you the whole award, so err heavy rather than delicate.

drills.title: Payoff Sweep
drills.text: Hold the left flipper through the plunge to light all five Payoff arrows, then take a different one each attempt — left orbit, briefcase lane, Pawn Shop scoop, Roll Scene saucer, right orbit. Rotating the pick stops you owning one payoff shot and guessing at the other four.

drills.title: Kahuna Ladder
drills.text: Single ball only: both Big Kahuna standups, then the Bullseye Magnet target, and repeat the three-shot chain to climb the playfield multiplier. The magnet catch at the end hands you a free trap — use it to set up the next lap instead of flipping straight back out.

drills.title: Insurance Backhand
drills.text: Settle the ball on the right flipper first, then backhand the Roll Scene drop target. This is a controlled shot, not a reflex swing, and the first two of them buy you a save on each outlane.
drills.reps: the first two shots of every ball

drills.title: Drive Fast Chain
drills.text: Roll an already-lit return lane, then immediately rip the opposite orbit — the right inlane lights the left orbit and the left inlane lights the right. Keep the loops going back and forth while the spinners build MPH, then cash it at the hidden Collect target behind the Pawn Shop bank before you drain.

drills.title: Late Collect Window
drills.text: Knock the Roll Scene drop, cycle to the scene you want on sling and bumper hits, start it at the saucer, then hold the return until the final ten seconds. Collecting early throws the whole snowball away — the discipline is waiting with a live ball, not making the shot.

actionButton.how: Nothing extra on this cabinet — flippers, the plunger, and your hips are the whole interface. The 1-2-3-4 top lanes change with the flipper buttons, and holding the left flipper while you plunge is what arms the Super Skill Shot, so the flipper buttons carry the small amount of off-playfield control the game asks for.

howItPlays.objective: Chase Big Kahuna playfield multipliers, then spend them on Roll Scene movie modes and payoff multiballs across the diner and the pawn shop. Light five objectives and clear Divine Intervention to double your entire score.
loop: Build Big Kahuna by taking both diner standups and the magnet target, doubling everything for the rest of the ball before you spend a cent of it.
Backhand the Roll Scene drop for outlane saves, cycle the pop bumpers to the scene you want, and start it at the right saucer.
Milk each scene by collecting in its last ten seconds, which repays it plus every scene before it and snowballs the total.
Lock at the pawn shop and the briefcase, spell PULP FICTION on the red arrows, and gather the cast -- all of it feeding the five objectives that open Divine Intervention.

lights.name: 1-2-3-4 Lanes and Bonus X
lights.lit: The two rollovers up by the saucer are the 1 and 2 of the 1-2-3-4 set, and the return lanes carry the 3 and 4; light all four and your bonus multiplier climbs while the Royale hurry-up begins.

control.effect: tapping a flipper button slides which of the lit 1 and 2 rollovers is active, so while the ball rattles around the pop nest you can shuffle the one you still need under it
control.when: while the ball is loose up in the bumpers, before it drops down a lane

lights.then: Steer the top pair with the flippers and pick up the 3 and 4 off ordinary returns to finish the set, stepping bonus toward its ceiling -- crossing a middle rung there also spots an extra ball. Each full set relights the Royale target for its hurry-up.

lights.name: Big Kahuna Playfield X
lights.lit: The two Big Kahuna standups by the pops light Advance at the magnet target; take both, then the magnet, and every point on the field doubles until you drain.
lights.then: Repeat the pair-then-magnet chain to stack the multiplier higher on a single ball, and do all of it before you open a scene or a multiball so the boost rides over the big stuff. The magnet grabs and parks the ball for you at the finish, handing you a free trap to set up the next climb.

lights.name: Payoff Shots
lights.lit: Five arrow inserts sit on the two orbits, the briefcase lane, the pawn scoop and the Roll Scene saucer; holding the left flipper on the plunge lights the whole set for the Super Skill Shot.
lights.flashing: All five strobe in color during Cast Chaos, each turning white as you collect it.
lights.then: Cash any lit arrow off a held plunge for a clean opener. Inside Cast Chaos, run the five in a lap and finish at the top saucer for the big Super Payoff, which relights the set to lap again -- roughly a million a loop with Kahuna riding on top.

lights.name: PULP FICTION Red Arrows
lights.lit: Seven red-arrow targets in three banks -- a pair low on the left, the center front-door trio and a pair on the right -- spell PULP FICTION, a letter for each bank you complete.
lights.then: Sweep the banks to fill the title; the center trio double-dips as pawn-shop lock progress, and the side pairs tend to fall while you shoot around them. Spell it out to erupt a four-ball frenzy at the scoop where every switch pays and each re-spell drops another fat scoop award.

lights.name: Roll Scene Movie Modes
lights.lit: Knocking the memory drop by the right saucer arms a scene and, as a bonus, lights a save on one outlane; which of the four scenes is up rides on the inserts and swaps on every sling or bumper rap.
lights.then: Rap the pops to line up the scene you want -- Gold Watch pays the most -- start it at the saucer, and build value for forty seconds. Collect in the final ten to bank that scene plus every one before it, and finishing all four opens The Shot, an untimed mini-wizard paid from your stacked scene total.

lights.name: Drive Fast MPH Loops
lights.lit: An already-lit return briefly wakes the opposite orbit for Drive Fast; catch that window and the loop keeps handing the ball back and forth while the orbit spinners crank up your speed reading.
lights.then: Chain the orbits with no miss to climb the per-loop value and pile on the miles, then cash it all at the hidden target tucked behind the pawn drops -- worth far more with the front drop down and Kahuna high. Push the counter past its mark and an extra ball lights; uncollected speed only survives between runs on the same ball, so bank it before you drain.

lights.name: Pawn Shop and Briefcase Locks
lights.lit: Two lock ladders run at once: the center front-door trio opens the subway scoop hidden behind it, and the inline drops in the briefcase lane guard a popper that kicks balls up to the case.
lights.then: Stash three in the scoop for the forgiving Pawn Shop Panic, or three behind the briefcase for Boogie, then farm each one's red-yellow-green payoff ladder up to its blue Super. Progress on both sets of drops is remembered ball to ball, and either Super checks off an objective toward Divine Intervention.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: This cabinet has no action button, so the flippers carry the lane change: tap either button to slide the lit 1 or 2 rollover across the top while the ball works the pop nest. Line the one you still need under the ball, and pick up the 3 and 4 off the return lanes -- each full 1-2-3-4 set adds a Bonus X (a middle rung lights an extra ball) and kicks off the Royale hurry-up.

scoring.text: Full-plunge for the arrow skill shot -- soft plunges only trickle back down the right orbit for nothing -- and buy outlane insurance early by backhanding the Roll Scene drop. Then run Big Kahuna up to a healthy playfield multiplier on the calm single ball before you spend it.
Turn the multiplier into points. Start a scene and milk the late collect, stack the forgiving Pawn Shop Panic multiball, assemble the cast for Cast Chaos, and spell the title for the frenzy.

Light all five objectives -- a briefcase Super, a pawn-shop Super, The Shot, the full cast and PULP FICTION -- to arm Divine Intervention. Survive its six renewing four-ball stages down to a single ball at the magnet, and your whole score doubles.
